notes.title: Notification Update(Ver.1.0.2)
notes.notes:
Announcement
- We have released Ver.1.0.2, which includes the following updates and fixes.

Update Details
Adjusted tutorial descriptions to make the game content easier to understand.

Simplified/Traditional Chinese Text Fixes
- Adjusted the translated text for Simplified and Traditional Chinese versions.
- Adjusted descriptions in the Apparition Encyclopedia for Simplified and Traditional Chinese versions.
- Fixed an issue where certain characters were not displaying correctly.

Thank you.

notes.title: Notification Update(Ver.1.0.1)
notes.notes:
Announcement
- We have released Ver.1.0.1, which includes the following updates and fixes.


Update Details
Changed it so that the Success Animation will now display in the dialogue scene after successfully completing the Fox Shrine Maiden's ritual 8 times in a row.

Improving Camera Operations
- Changed the camera reset operation so it can now be performed with a right-click of the mouse.
- Adjusting the time it takes for the camera angle to reset after being changed during 
the Fox Shrine Maiden's ritual.

Other
- Added an option in the settings menu to lock the input device.
 　Use this option if mouse and keyboard gameplay is unstable in certain environments where a gamepad 　is also connected.
　* This setting is generally unnecessary, as the appropriate device is automatically detected.
- Minor bug fixes and text error corrections


Thank you.
